_readme: S750, the cheap piles (2026-11-28). Plan s750a files the reading state_course_not_on_page (kb/_program_named_gaps.py, S748) where the committed capture finds a state-listed course on no line of the program's own page. The reading's fires are wrong about 4 times in 100, so each row is checked against a free read of its own page before it is planned: this read prints the page so a session and the plan's second reader can see whether any line prints the course. No model call, nothing written. College of Marin Studio Arts A.A.-T 46242: ART 135. Round 2: run 46149637666 printed the rendered page with its PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS section collapsed, so no course row showed. This round opens the collapsed sections on the rendered page, and reads the page's own content call, the one the capture reads (kb/_program_requirements_college.py el_publish_url).

questions.art_135: Whether the Studio Arts A.A.-T page prints ART 135 (the page writes codes with no space, ART135) on any line, and each ART row it prints.
